title: Harper Academy 4 Future Nuclear Engineers
sponsor: University of Michigan, Nuclear Engineering and Radiological Sciences
pay_text: Free to attend, and students receive a stipend
who_text: High school students who will be seniors in the fall (rising 12th graders)
description: A four-week summer program on the University of Michigan campus in Ann Arbor where you live in a residence hall and explore nuclear engineering. Mornings cover math, science and college entrance exam prep, and afternoons cover leadership and design projects. The camp is free and you are paid a stipend.
